requirements: INV-09-1: final weight keys are ExposureSelector vehicles when master is set; score tickers never force leveraged isu_cd without selector
INV-09-2: leverage_allowed is None => all selected leverage_multiple == 1 (fail-closed UNKNOWN)
INV-09-3: confidence LOW => force +1x regardless of leverage_allowed True
INV-09-4: after allocate, gross_exposure(weights, multiples) <= max_gross_exposure (default 1.60 from configs/portfolio.yaml)
INV-09-5: liquidity cap after vehicle remap uses ADV of the vehicle ticker; if ADV insufficient demote to +1x
INV-09-6: no synthetic leverage returns — only real family member tickers (INV-14)
INV-09-7: AggressionPolicy enabled defaults False; apply returns 1.0; when enabled scale weights then renormalize sum<=1
allocate O(K) vehicle pass with K<=max_positions; no O(N_tickers) family scans beyond selected keys
PortfolioDecision.rationale entries MUST include vehicle= and mult= when vehicle pass runs
BacktestEngine/simulator/replay MUST pass regime state string and rules.leverage_allowed into allocate when model has allocate
Harness research: when rules.leverage_allowed is UNKNOWN, run two explicit scenarios (True and False) — do not invent a single blended path
Immutable: do not change NextOpenExecution, CostModel, or INV-10 fill timing

scenarios.expected_behavior: target_multiple_for_regime(None|NEUTRAL|RISK_OFF, leverage_allowed=True, inverse_allowed=None) == 1; STRONG_RISK_ON|RISK_ON with leverage_allowed=True == 2; any regime with leverage_allowed=None == 1
ExposureSelector.select(family, leverage_allowed=None) returns +1x ticker; select(..., leverage_allowed=True, confidence_low=False, regime='RISK_ON') returns +2x when family has multiple==2
confidence_low=True forces +1x even when leverage_allowed=True and regime=RISK_ON (INV-19)
gross_exposure({'A':0.8}, {'A':2}) == 1.6; apply_gross_exposure_cap({'A':0.9}, {'A':2}, max_gross=1.60) yields G<=1.60 within 1e-9

PortfolioPolicy(master=family_master).allocate(scores, regime='RISK_ON', leverage_allowed=True) remaps +1 ticker to +2 vehicle; decision.vehicles maps src->dst; rationale values contain 'vehicle=' and 'mult='
allocate(..., leverage_allowed=None) keeps multiples==1 for all weight keys; decision.gross <= max_gross_exposure
after vehicle remap to +2x, apply_liquidity_cap uses adv[vehicle]; if adv[vehicle]*participation/capital < weight then demote to +1x or reduce weight so final notional <= ADV*phi
AggressionPolicy(enabled=False).apply(any) == 1.0; PortfolioPolicy with aggression enabled scales weights by multiplier then sum(weights) <= 1.0 + 1e-9
cmd_decide exit 0; stdout contains 'vehicle=' OR rationale with vehicle=; decision artifact selected[].reason non-empty and includes mult= when master available

BacktestEngine path calling model.allocate passes leverage_allowed from TournamentRules (or explicit kwarg); with leverage_allowed=False engine never holds ticker with leverage_multiple!=1 from master
